Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek
Separate mouse/keyboard and controller settings. All enabled by default. Confirm to apply and save.
Mouse / Keyboard
Controller
Defaults for this page
Automatically enter attack mode
Selecting a ranged unit with a valid visible target opens attack targeting. Native right-click or controller Cancel still cancels.
Automatically enter join mode
Without a reachable enemy, automatically enter join mode when an eligible friendly commander is on the same or adjacent tile.
Right-click to join a commander
Right-click joins only when another friendly military unit shares the commander tile. Otherwise retain normal movement. Invalid joins on occupied tiles block move/swap.
Automatically enter deployment mode
Selecting an individual packed unit opens deployment targeting. Selecting the commander does not unpack the entire army.
Confirm the only reinforcement target
After clicking Reinforce, send directly only if you own exactly one commander and it is eligible. Owning multiple commanders always requires a choice.
Pink marker for empty commanders
Show a faint pink tile under friendly commanders with no packed units. Updates when the active input device changes.
All 23 checkboxes
Enable all applicable Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek options. Use the native Confirm button to save, or Cancel to discard.
Reset Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek
Micromanagement Master Chiang Kai-shek settings not saved
Could not write local mod settings. Your changes have not been saved. Check the settings data and retry; other mods’ data has been preserved.
Keep commander selected after deployment
After deployment, retain commander selection while military units remain packed. Civilians and recon units do not count.
Select next deployable military unit
After deployment, select and highlight the next packed military unit with movement and a legal deployment plot. Independent of commander retention.
Select next ranged attacker
After a manual ranged attack, select another ready unit of the same type under the same commander with a visible stationary attack target.
Preview stationary volley participants

Show persistent gold frames around the selected ranged formation. Hover an enemy to preview red attack arrows only from selected units that can fire without moving. Keep focused-fire bonuses and fire farthest first.
Exclude stationary volley participants

Requires participant preview. All ranged units in command range start selected. Click a friendly unit to remove or restore its gold frame. Hover an enemy to preview eligible attackers, then click it to fire.
Cycle reinforcement commanders
Preview the closest owned commander. Cycle with LB/RB, Up/Down, wheel or panel buttons. Ineligible commanders remain visible but cannot be confirmed.

微操大师常凯申
鼠标／键盘和手柄分别配置，默认全部开启。确认后生效并保存。
鼠标／键盘
手柄
本页默认设置
自动进入攻击模式
选中单位时，有可攻击的可见敌人就自动进入攻击选格。右键或手柄 B 仍可取消。
自动进入加入模式
没有可攻击敌人，且同格或相邻一格有可加入的己方指挥官时，直接进入加入模式。
右键加入指挥官
仅当指挥官所在格还有其他己方军事单位时，右键改为加入；该情况下无法加入则阻止换位。空格仍正常移动。
自动进入退出模式
选中指挥官内已收纳的单个单位后，直接选择退出落点。选中指挥官本人不展开整军。
自动确认唯一增援目标
主动点击增援后，只有总共拥有一位指挥官且其可接收时才直接派遣。拥有多位时，即使仅一位合法，也必须选择。
空指挥官粉色底座
己方指挥官内没有实际收纳单位时，脚下显示淡粉色底座。切换输入设备时按对应组设置刷新。
全部 23 项设置
启用微操大师常凯申的所有适用设置。点击原生“确认变更”保存，取消则放弃。
恢复微操大师常凯申默认
微操大师常凯申设置未保存
本地 Mod 设置数据无法写入，本次修改尚未保存。请检查本地设置后重试；其他 Mod 的存储数据已保留。
部署后保持指挥官焦点
派出单位后，只要仍收纳军事单位，就保留指挥官选择；不计平民和侦察单位。
自动选择下一个可派出单位
部署后自动选中仍有移动力且存在合法退出格的军事单位，并高亮头像。与保持指挥官焦点分别开关。
攻击后选择下一个远程单位
手动远程攻击结束后，选择同一指挥官范围内、同类型且当前能原地攻击可见敌人的单位。
原地火力参与者高亮
进入集中火力后，已选远程编队持续显示金框。悬停敌人时，仅可原地攻击该敌人的已选单位显示红色攻击箭头；保留集中火力加成，远处单位优先射击。
原地火力手动排除单位
需要开启参与者高亮。默认选中指挥范围内的远程单位；直接点击友军取消或恢复选择，取消后金框消失。悬停敌人查看可参与攻击者，点击敌人开火。
增援指挥官快速切换
默认预览最近的己方指挥官；LB／RB、键盘上下、滚轮或面板按钮切换。不可增援的指挥官仍显示但不能确认。
